notes.title: December 14 Update: Fixes and Tweaks
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has enjoyed the game so far, and to those who have provided me with great feedback!

I've added some small tweaks to the game:

- addressed vsync issue with performance affecting some players
- visibility of certain background elements reduced for clarity
- slight adjustment to difficulty of one area
- other small bug fixes
